input.content:
"""Randomised scenarios against an independent reference.

A generator invents a tender (the ground truth), then writes it into facts the way messy sites present it: decoys
are added (superseded, look-alike, future-dated and wrong-sender records; inactive and near-miss materials; old
revisions and their amendments; withdrawn and superseded clarifications; expired and future price conditions), the
lists are shuffled, position numbers come in several styles and some keys come without a Q&A number. A deliberately
simple reference computes the expected answer from the ground truth alone, with Fractions instead of Decimal, so it
shares no code with the engine. Every answer field must agree. All data is invented.
"""
import math
import random
import unittest
from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from datetime import date, datetime, timedelta, timezone
from decimal import Decimal as D
from fractions import Fraction as F

import test_engine_base  # noqa: F401  (puts agent/ on the path)

from engine import evaluate
from facts import (Assignment, AssignmentKind as K, Attr, BonusBand, ConditionGroupRule, DeliveryCommitment,
                   DiscountApproval, DiscountScope, EndReserve, Facts, FxRate, IndexWindow, Material, MetalIndex,
                   PackagingTariff, PriceCondition, ProjectBonus, QuantityChange, Requirement, Scale, SetupPool, Source,
                   SpecRevision, TechnicalAmendment, TenderPosition, Unit, Withdrawal)

SEEDS = range(300)
UTC = timezone.utc
SCEN = datetime(2030, 6, 15, 12, 0, tzinfo=UTC)
REF, LOOK = "T-RND-7", "T-RND-7-X"
DOMAIN, DIRECTOR = "bidder.test", "chef@bidder.test"


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Ground truth


@dataclass
class TMat:
    number: str
    group: str
    bore: int
    stroke: int                 # nominal stroke, what the ERP shows
    pressure: int
    mounting: str
    cert: str                   # "" = none
    stock: int
    stock_lead: int
    prod_lead: int
    carton: int
    alloc_kg: D
    mass_kg: D
    index: str                  # "" = no metal index
    index_rate: D
    setup: D
    usd: bool
    price_unit: int
    scales: list                # [(min pieces, price per price_unit)]
    usable: bool = False        # the requirement states usable travel
    reserve: int = 0


@dataclass
class TPos:
    id: str
    mat: TMat
    is_set: bool
    pps: int                    # pieces per set of its requirement
    tender_qty: int             # in the position's unit
    stated: int                 # final quantity in the position's unit
    scope: DiscountScope | None = None
    packaging: bool = False
    pool: bool = False
    bonus: bool = False
    commit: tuple | None = None  # (material number, ceiling, weeks)

    @property
    def pieces(self):
        return self.stated * (self.pps if self.is_set else 1)


@dataclass
class World:
    positions: list
    mats: list
    fx: D
    approval: tuple | None      # (percent, min order value or None)
    scope_keys: dict            # key -> scope
    tariff: D
    pool_fee: D
    bands: list                 # [(lower, upper or None, percent)]
    no_bid: bool = False
    facts: Facts = None
    notes: list = field(default_factory=list)


def money(rng, lo, hi):
    return D(rng.randint(int(lo * 100), int(hi * 100))) / 100


def invent(seed: int) -> World:
    rng = random.Random(seed)
    n = rng.randint(1, 5)
    style = rng.choice(["num", "tens", "dotted", "alpha"])
    ids = [{"num": str(i + 1), "tens": str(10 * (i + 1)), "dotted": f"1.{i + 1}", "alpha": f"P-{i + 1:02d}"}[style]
           for i in range(n)]
    k = rng.randint(1, n)
    mats = []
    for i in range(k):
        price_unit = rng.choice([1, 1, 10, 100])
        mins = sorted({1, rng.randint(2, 15), rng.randint(16, 60)})
        price = money(rng, 20, 900) * price_unit
        scales = []
        for m in mins:
            scales.append((m, price))
            price = (price * D(rng.randint(85, 99)) / 100).quantize(D("0.01"))
        mats.append(TMat(
            number=f"M-{seed}-{i}", group=f"G-{i}", bore=rng.choice([32, 40, 50, 63, 80, 100]),
            stroke=200 + 60 * i + 10 * rng.randint(0, 4), pressure=rng.choice([160, 200, 210, 250]),
            mounting=rng.choice(["Flansch", "Schwenkauge", "Fußbefestigung", "Gewindezapfen"]),
            cert=rng.choice(["", "", "EN 1000", "EN 2000"]), stock=rng.randint(0, 60), stock_lead=rng.randint(1, 3),
            prod_lead=rng.randint(4, 12), carton=rng.randint(1, 12), alloc_kg=D(rng.randint(500, 5000)) / 1000,
            mass_kg=D(rng.randint(100, 2000)) / 1000, index=rng.choice(["", f"IX-{i}", f"IX-{i}"]),
            index_rate=money(rng, 1.5, 5), setup=rng.choice([D(0), money(rng, 10, 200)]), usd=rng.random() < 0.3,
            price_unit=price_unit, scales=scales, usable=rng.random() < 0.3, reserve=rng.randint(3, 15)))
    positions = []
    for i, pid in enumerate(ids):
        mat = mats[i] if i < k else rng.choice(mats)
        is_set = rng.random() < 0.25
        tender = rng.randint(1, 20) if is_set else rng.randint(1, 80)
        stated = rng.choice([tender, tender, rng.randint(1, 80)])
        positions.append(TPos(pid, mat, is_set, rng.randint(2, 6), tender, stated))
    # pieces per set belong to the requirement: positions of one material share them
    for p in positions:
        p.pps = next(q.pps for q in positions if q.mat is p.mat)
    scope_keys = {f"KG-{j}": rng.choice(list(DiscountScope)) for j in range(3)}
    for p in positions:
        if rng.random() < 0.4:
            p.scope = rng.choice(list(scope_keys))
        p.packaging = rng.random() < 0.5
        p.pool = rng.random() < 0.4
        p.bonus = rng.random() < 0.5
    pooled = {}
    for p in positions:
        pooled[p.mat.number] = pooled.get(p.mat.number, 0) + p.pieces
    for p in positions:
        if rng.random() < 0.3:
            number = p.mat.number if rng.random() < 0.7 else f"M-{seed}-other"
            ceiling = max(0, pooled[p.mat.number] + rng.choice([0, -1, 5]))
            p.commit = (number, ceiling, rng.randint(1, 3))
    t1 = money(rng, 200, 3000)
    bands = [(D(0), t1, D(0)), (t1, t1 + money(rng, 500, 5000), D(rng.choice([1, 2, 3]))),
             (None, None, D(rng.choice([4, 5])))]
    bands[2] = (bands[1][1], None, bands[2][2])
    world = World(positions, mats, fx=D(rng.randint(8000, 13000)) / 10000, approval=None, scope_keys=scope_keys,
                  tariff=money(rng, 1, 30), pool_fee=money(rng, 10, 900), bands=bands)
    if rng.random() < 0.85:
        percent = rng.choice([D(2), D("2.5"), D(3), D(5), D("7.5")])
        minimum = None
        if rng.random() < 0.5:
            value = reference_order_value(world)
            minimum = rng.choice([value, value + D("0.01"), value - D("0.01"), (value / 2).quantize(D("0.01")),
                                  value * 2])
        world.approval = (percent, minimum)
    world.no_bid = rng.random() < 0.1
    world.facts = render(world, rng)
    return world


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Reference (Fractions, written from the rule text, no engine code)


def r2(x: F) -> F:
    return F(math.floor(x * 100 + F(1, 2)), 100)


def base_price(world: World, p: TPos) -> F:
    reached = [price for minimum, price in p.mat.scales if minimum <= p.pieces]
    per_piece = F(reached[-1]) / p.mat.price_unit
    return r2(per_piece * F(world.fx)) if p.mat.usd else per_piece


def reference_order_value(world: World) -> D:
    value = r2(sum((p.pieces * base_price(world, p) for p in world.positions), F(0)))
    return D(value.numerator) / D(value.denominator)


def largest_remainder(total: F, weights: dict, order: list) -> dict:
    cents = int(total * 100)
    whole = sum(weights.values(), F(0))
    exact = {k: cents * w / whole for k, w in weights.items()}
    got = {k: math.floor(v) for k, v in exact.items()}
    rest = cents - sum(got.values())
    for k in sorted(weights, key=lambda k: (-(exact[k] - got[k]), order.index(k)))[:rest]:
        got[k] += 1
    return {k: F(v, 100) for k, v in got.items()}


def reference(world: World) -> dict:
    percent = F(0)
    if world.approval:
        pct, minimum = world.approval
        if minimum is None or (not world.no_bid and reference_order_value(world) >= minimum):
            percent = F(pct)
    head = {"tender_reference": REF, "currency": "EUR", "discount_percent": percent}
    if world.no_bid:
        return {**head, "decision": "no_bid", "positions": [], "total_net": F(0)}
    order = [p.id for p in world.positions]
    base = {p.id: base_price(world, p) for p in world.positions}
    pool = {p.id: F(0) for p in world.positions}
    members = [p for p in world.positions if p.pool]
    if members:
        pool.update(largest_remainder(F(world.pool_fee), {p.id: p.pieces * F(p.mat.alloc_kg) for p in members}, order))
    bonus = {p.id: F(0) for p in world.positions}
    members = [p for p in world.positions if p.bonus]
    if members:
        values = {p.id: p.pieces * base[p.id] for p in members}
        total = sum(values.values(), F(0))
        credit = F(0)
        for lower, upper, pct in world.bands:
            top = total if upper is None else min(total, F(upper))
            credit += max(F(0), top - F(lower)) * F(pct) / 100
        credit = r2(credit)
        if credit:
            bonus.update(largest_remainder(credit, values, order))
    pooled = {}
    for p in world.positions:
        pooled[p.mat.number] = pooled.get(p.mat.number, 0) + p.pieces
    keep = 1 - percent / 100
    out, total_net = [], F(0)
    for p in world.positions:
        m, q = p.mat, p.pieces
        mass = F(m.mass_kg) * F(m.index_rate) if m.index else F(0)
        packaging = math.ceil(F(q, m.carton)) * F(world.tariff) if p.packaging else F(0)
        scope = world.scope_keys[p.scope] if p.scope else DiscountScope.BASE
        b = base[p.id] * keep if scope in (DiscountScope.BASE, DiscountScope.BASE_AND_SURCHARGE) else base[p.id]
        s = mass * keep if scope == DiscountScope.BASE_AND_SURCHARGE else mass
        unit = r2(b + s + (F(m.setup) + pool[p.id] + packaging - bonus[p.id]) / q)
        if p.commit and p.commit[0] == m.number and pooled[m.number] <= p.commit[1]:
            lead = p.commit[2]
        else:
            lead = m.stock_lead if m.stock >= pooled[m.number] else m.prod_lead
        total_net += q * unit
        out.append({"position": p.id, "material_number": m.number, "quantity": q, "unit_price": unit,
                    "lead_time_weeks": lead, "base_unit_price": r2(base[p.id]),
                    "surcharge_per_unit": r2(mass + (F(m.setup) + pool[p.id]) / q),
                    "packaging_per_unit": r2(packaging / q), "rebate_total": bonus[p.id]})
    return {**head, "decision": "bid", "positions": out, "total_net": total_net}


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Rendering the truth into facts, with decoys


def render(w: World, rng: random.Random) -> Facts:
    clock = [datetime(2030, 3, 1, 8, 0, tzinfo=UTC)]

    def qa_time():
        clock[0] += timedelta(hours=rng.randint(1, 60))
        return clock[0]

    def true_time():          # a record date not after the scenario date (sometimes the same morning)
        return rng.choice([SCEN - timedelta(hours=rng.randint(1, 3)), SCEN - timedelta(days=rng.randint(1, 30))])

    def src(when, local="", domain=DOMAIN):
        return Source(date=when, sender=f"{local}@{domain}" if local else "")

    def keyed(make, local, key, true_value, other_value):
        """The authorized record plus decoys: superseded older, look-alike newer, future, wrong sender/domain."""
        t = true_time()
        return [make(REF, key, true_value, src(t, local)),
                make(REF, key, other_value, src(t - timedelta(days=rng.randint(1, 9)), local)),
                make(LOOK, key, other_value, src(SCEN - timedelta(minutes=30), local)),
                make(REF, key, other_value, src(SCEN + timedelta(minutes=rng.choice([1, 60 * 24])), local)),
                make(REF, key, other_value, src(SCEN - timedelta(minutes=10), "vertrieb")),
                make(REF, key, other_value, src(SCEN - timedelta(minutes=5), local, "other.test"))]

    f = Facts(tender_reference=REF, scenario_date=SCEN, bidder_domain=DOMAIN, director_address=DIRECTOR)
    numbers = iter(range(1, 1000))

    # revisions, requirements, amendments, end reserves
    cur, old = f"REV-{rng.randint(100, 999)}", f"REV-{rng.randint(1000, 1999)}"
    cur_reqs, old_reqs = [], []
    for m in w.mats:
        p_set = next(p for p in w.positions if p.mat is m)
        stroke = m.stroke - 2 * m.reserve if m.usable else m.stroke
        req = Requirement(f"A{m.group}", D(m.bore), D(stroke), D(m.pressure), m.mounting,
                          m.cert or rng.choice(["keine gefordert", "", None]), catalogue_group=m.group,
                          pieces_per_set=D(p_set.pps), usable_travel=m.usable, end_reserve_key=f"E-{m.group}")
        if rng.random() < 0.5:        # the revision states another value; the latest amendment restores the truth
            attr, wrong, right = ((Attr.STROKE, req.stroke_mm + 20, req.stroke_mm) if rng.random() < 0.5
                                  else (Attr.PRESSURE, D(m.pressure + 5), D(m.pressure)))
            req = Requirement(**{**req.__dict__, attr.value: wrong})
            f.amendments += [
                TechnicalAmendment(cur, req.requirement, attr, str(wrong + 1), f"F-{next(numbers)}", src(qa_time())),
                TechnicalAmendment(cur, req.requirement, attr, str(right), f"F-{next(numbers)}", src(qa_time())),
                TechnicalAmendment(old, req.requirement, attr, str(wrong + 2), f"F-{next(numbers)}", src(qa_time()))]
        cur_reqs.append(req)
        old_reqs.append(Requirement(**{**req.__dict__, "stroke_mm": req.stroke_mm + 10}))
        if m.usable:
            f.end_reserves += keyed(lambda r, k, v, s: EndReserve(r, k, cur, D(v), s), "technik", f"E-{m.group}",
                                    m.reserve, m.reserve + 2)
            f.end_reserves.append(EndReserve(REF, f"E-{m.group}", old, D(m.reserve + 5), src(true_time(), "technik")))
    f.revisions = [SpecRevision(cur, True, date(2030, 2, rng.randint(1, 28)), cur_reqs),
                   SpecRevision(old, rng.choice([False, None]), date(2030, rng.choice([1, 3]), 10), old_reqs)]

    # positions and clarifications
    for p in w.positions:
        f.positions.append(TenderPosition(p.id, D(p.tender_qty), Unit.SET if p.is_set else Unit.PIECE,
                                          f"A{p.mat.group}"))
        wrong = p.stated + rng.randint(1, 9)
        story = rng.choice(["none", "change", "two", "withdrawn_later", "withdrawn_only"])
        if p.stated != p.tender_qty and story in ("none", "withdrawn_only"):
            story = "change"
        if story in ("change", "withdrawn_later"):
            f.quantity_changes.append(QuantityChange(p.id, D(p.stated), f"F-{next(numbers)}", src(qa_time())))
        if story == "two":
            f.quantity_changes.append(QuantityChange(p.id, D(wrong), f"F-{next(numbers)}", src(qa_time())))
            f.quantity_changes.append(QuantityChange(p.id, D(p.stated), f"F-{next(numbers)}", src(qa_time())))
        if story in ("withdrawn_later", "withdrawn_only"):
            n = f"F-{next(numbers)}"
            f.quantity_changes.append(QuantityChange(p.id, D(wrong), n, src(qa_time())))
            f.withdrawals.append(Withdrawal(f"F-{next(numbers)}", n, src(qa_time())))

    # materials with decoys and price conditions
    removed = rng.choice(w.mats).number if w.no_bid else None
    for m in w.mats:
        valid = PriceCondition(datetime(2030, 1, 1, tzinfo=UTC), datetime(2030, 12, 31, 23, 59, 59, tzinfo=UTC),
                               "USD" if m.usd else "EUR", "FX-1" if m.usd else "", D(m.price_unit),
                               [Scale(D(q), price) for q, price in m.scales])
        expired = PriceCondition(date(2029, 1, 1), date(2029, 12, 31), "EUR", "", D(1), [Scale(D(1), D("1.11"))])
        future = PriceCondition(SCEN + timedelta(hours=1), None, "EUR", "", D(1), [Scale(D(1), D("2.22"))])
        true = Material(m.number, True, m.group, D(m.bore), D(m.stroke), D(m.pressure),
                        rng.choice([m.mounting, m.mounting.lower(), m.mounting.upper()]),
                        m.cert or rng.choice(["", None, "keine"]), D(m.stock), m.stock_lead, m.prod_lead,
                        D(m.carton), m.alloc_kg, m.mass_kg, m.index, m.setup, rng.sample([valid, expired, future], 3))
        decoys = [Material(**{**true.__dict__, "material_number": m.number + "-I", "active": False}),
                  Material(**{**true.__dict__, "material_number": m.number + "-N",
                              rng.choice(["bore_mm", "pressure_bar", "stroke_mm"]): D(rng.choice([1, 2, 3, 4])) +
                              getattr(true, "bore_mm")})]
        if m.usable:     # the trap: a material whose stroke is the usable travel without reserves
            decoys.append(Material(**{**true.__dict__, "material_number": m.number + "-U",
                                      "stroke_mm": D(m.stroke - 2 * m.reserve)}))
        f.materials += decoys + ([] if m.number == removed else [true])
        if m.index:
            day = SCEN.date()
            start = rng.choice([day, day - timedelta(days=rng.randint(1, 40))])
            end = rng.choice([day, day + timedelta(days=rng.randint(1, 40))])
            windows = [IndexWindow(m.index_rate + 1, None, start - timedelta(days=1)),
                       IndexWindow(m.index_rate, start, end), IndexWindow(m.index_rate + 2, end + timedelta(days=1))]
            rng.shuffle(windows)
            f.metal_indices += keyed(lambda r, k, v, s: MetalIndex(r, k, v, s), "kalkulation", m.index, windows,
                                     [IndexWindow(m.index_rate + 3)])
    f.searched_groups = [m.group for m in w.mats]
    f.fx_rates = keyed(lambda r, k, v, s: FxRate(r, k, "USD", v, s), "finanzen", "FX-1", w.fx, w.fx + D("0.1"))

    # keys and their assignments (some without a Q&A number, as if read from another site)
    def assign(p, kind, key):
        number = rng.choice([f"F-{next(numbers)}", ""])
        if rng.random() < 0.3:      # an older assignment to another key, replaced by the true one
            f.assignments.append(Assignment(p.id, kind, key + "-OLD", "", src(qa_time())))
        f.assignments.append(Assignment(p.id, kind, key, number, src(qa_time())))

    for key, scope in w.scope_keys.items():
        other = rng.choice([s for s in DiscountScope if s != scope])
        f.condition_groups += keyed(lambda r, k, v, s: ConditionGroupRule(r, k, v, s), "kalkulation", key, scope, other)
    f.packaging_tariffs = keyed(lambda r, k, v, s: PackagingTariff(r, k, v, s), "logistik", "VP-1", w.tariff,
                                w.tariff + 7)
    f.packaging_tariffs.append(PackagingTariff(REF, "VP-1-OLD", D(99), src(true_time(), "logistik")))
    f.setup_pools = keyed(lambda r, k, v, s: SetupPool(r, k, v, s), "kalkulation", "RP-1", w.pool_fee,
                          w.pool_fee + 50)
    bands = [BonusBand(lo, hi, pct) for lo, hi, pct in w.bands]
    f.project_bonuses = keyed(lambda r, k, v, s: ProjectBonus(r, k, v, s), "finanzen", "PB-1", bands,
                              [BonusBand(D(0), None, D(20))])
    for p in w.positions:
        if p.scope:
            assign(p, K.CONDITION_GROUP, p.scope)
        if p.packaging:
            assign(p, K.PACKAGING, "VP-1")
        if p.pool:
            assign(p, K.SETUP_POOL, "RP-1")
        if p.bonus:
            assign(p, K.PROJECT_BONUS, "PB-1")
        if p.commit:
            key = f"TZ-{p.id}"
            number, ceiling, weeks = p.commit
            f.delivery_commitments += keyed(
                lambda r, k, v, s: DeliveryCommitment(r, k, number, D(ceiling), v, s), "logistik", key, weeks, 0)
            assign(p, K.DELIVERY, key)

    if w.approval:
        pct, minimum = w.approval
        t = true_time()
        f.discount_approvals = [
            DiscountApproval(REF, pct, minimum, src(t, "chef")),
            DiscountApproval(REF, D(1), None, src(t - timedelta(days=2), "chef")),
            DiscountApproval(LOOK, D(9), None, src(SCEN - timedelta(minutes=20), "chef")),
            DiscountApproval(REF, D(9), None, src(SCEN + timedelta(minutes=1), "chef")),
            DiscountApproval(REF, D(9), None, src(SCEN - timedelta(minutes=10), "vertrieb"))]

    for items in (f.positions, f.quantity_changes, f.withdrawals, f.amendments, f.assignments, f.materials,
                  f.discount_approvals, f.condition_groups, f.metal_indices, f.packaging_tariffs,
                  f.delivery_commitments, f.fx_rates, f.setup_pools, f.project_bonuses, f.end_reserves, f.revisions):
        rng.shuffle(items)
    return f


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------


def as_dec(x) -> D:
    if isinstance(x, F):
        return D(x.numerator) / D(x.denominator)
    return D(str(x))


class RandomScenarios(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_engine_matches_reference(self):
        for seed in SEEDS:
            with self.subTest(seed=seed):
                world = invent(seed)
                result = evaluate(world.facts)
                want, got = reference(world), result.answer
                self.assertEqual(result.incomplete, [])
                self.assertEqual(got["decision"], want["decision"])
                for name in ("tender_reference", "currency"):
                    self.assertEqual(got[name], want[name])
                for name in ("discount_percent", "total_net"):
                    self.assertEqual(as_dec(got[name]), as_dec(want[name]), name)
                self.assertEqual([p["position"] for p in got["positions"]],
                                 [p["position"] for p in want["positions"]])
                for g, e in zip(got["positions"], want["positions"]):
                    self.assertEqual(set(g), set(e), g["position"])
                    for name in e:
                        if isinstance(e[name], str):
                            self.assertEqual(g[name], e[name], (g["position"], name))
                        else:
                            self.assertEqual(as_dec(g[name]), as_dec(e[name]), (g["position"], name))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()

"""Randomised scenarios against an independent reference.

A generator invents a tender (the ground truth), then writes it into facts the way messy sites present it: decoys
are added (superseded, look-alike, future-dated and wrong-sender records; inactive and near-miss materials; old
revisions and their amendments; withdrawn and superseded clarifications; expired and future price conditions), the
lists are shuffled, position numbers come in several styles and some keys come without a Q&A number. A deliberately
simple reference computes the expected answer from the ground truth alone, with Fractions instead of Decimal, so it
shares no code with the engine. Every answer field must agree. All data is invented.
"""
import math
import random
import unittest
from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from datetime import date, datetime, timedelta, timezone
from decimal import Decimal as D
from fractions import Fraction as F

import test_engine_base  # noqa: F401  (puts agent/ on the path)

from engine import evaluate
from facts import (Assignment, AssignmentKind as K, Attr, BonusBand, ConditionGroupRule, DeliveryCommitment,
                   DiscountApproval, DiscountScope, EndReserve, Facts, FxRate, IndexWindow, Material, MetalIndex,
                   PackagingTariff, PriceCondition, ProjectBonus, QuantityChange, Requirement, Scale, SetupPool, Source,
                   SpecRevision, TechnicalAmendment, TenderPosition, Unit, Withdrawal)

SEEDS = range(300)
UTC = timezone.utc
SCEN = datetime(2030, 6, 15, 12, 0, tzinfo=UTC)
REF, LOOK = "T-RND-7", "T-RND-7-X"
DOMAIN, DIRECTOR = "bidder.test", "chef@bidder.test"


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Ground truth


@dataclass
class TMat:
    number: str
    group: str
    bore: int
    stroke: int                 # nominal stroke, what the ERP shows
    pressure: int
    mounting: str
    cert: str                   # "" = none
    stock: int
    stock_lead: int
    prod_lead: int
    carton: int
    alloc_kg: D
    mass_kg: D
    index: str                  # "" = no metal index
    index_rate: D
    setup: D
    usd: bool
    price_unit: int
    scales: list                # [(min pieces, price per price_unit)]
    usable: bool = False        # the requirement states usable travel
    reserve: int = 0


@dataclass
class TPos:
    id: str
    mat: TMat
    is_set: bool
    pps: int                    # pieces per set of its requirement
    tender_qty: int             # in the position's unit
    stated: int                 # final quantity in the position's unit
    scope: DiscountScope | None = None
    packaging: bool = False
    pool: bool = False
    bonus: bool = False
    commit: tuple | None = None  # (material number, ceiling, weeks)

    @property
    def pieces(self):
        return self.stated * (self.pps if self.is_set else 1)


@dataclass
class World:
    positions: list
    mats: list
    fx: D
    approval: tuple | None      # (percent, min order value or None)
    scope_keys: dict            # key -> scope
    tariff: D
    pool_fee: D
    bands: list                 # [(lower, upper or None, percent)]
    no_bid: bool = False
    facts: Facts = None
    notes: list = field(default_factory=list)


def money(rng, lo, hi):
    return D(rng.randint(int(lo * 100), int(hi * 100))) / 100


def invent(seed: int) -> World:
    rng = random.Random(seed)
    n = rng.randint(1, 5)
    style = rng.choice(["num", "tens", "dotted", "alpha"])
    ids = [{"num": str(i + 1), "tens": str(10 * (i + 1)), "dotted": f"1.{i + 1}", "alpha": f"P-{i + 1:02d}"}[style]
           for i in range(n)]
    k = rng.randint(1, n)
    mats = []
    for i in range(k):
        price_unit = rng.choice([1, 1, 10, 100])
        mins = sorted({1, rng.randint(2, 15), rng.randint(16, 60)})
        price = money(rng, 20, 900) * price_unit
        scales = []
        for m in mins:
            scales.append((m, price))
            price = (price * D(rng.randint(85, 99)) / 100).quantize(D("0.01"))
        mats.append(TMat(
            number=f"M-{seed}-{i}", group=f"G-{i}", bore=rng.choice([32, 40, 50, 63, 80, 100]),
            stroke=200 + 60 * i + 10 * rng.randint(0, 4), pressure=rng.choice([160, 200, 210, 250]),
            mounting=rng.choice(["Flansch", "Schwenkauge", "Fußbefestigung", "Gewindezapfen"]),
            cert=rng.choice(["", "", "EN 1000", "EN 2000"]), stock=rng.randint(0, 60), stock_lead=rng.randint(1, 3),
            prod_lead=rng.randint(4, 12), carton=rng.randint(1, 12), alloc_kg=D(rng.randint(500, 5000)) / 1000,
            mass_kg=D(rng.randint(100, 2000)) / 1000, index=rng.choice(["", f"IX-{i}", f"IX-{i}"]),
            index_rate=money(rng, 1.5, 5), setup=rng.choice([D(0), money(rng, 10, 200)]), usd=rng.random() < 0.3,
            price_unit=price_unit, scales=scales, usable=rng.random() < 0.3, reserve=rng.randint(3, 15)))
    positions = []
    for i, pid in enumerate(ids):
        mat = mats[i] if i < k else rng.choice(mats)
        is_set = rng.random() < 0.25
        tender = rng.randint(1, 20) if is_set else rng.randint(1, 80)
        stated = rng.choice([tender, tender, rng.randint(1, 80)])
        positions.append(TPos(pid, mat, is_set, rng.randint(2, 6), tender, stated))
    # pieces per set belong to the requirement: positions of one material share them
    for p in positions:
        p.pps = next(q.pps for q in positions if q.mat is p.mat)
    scope_keys = {f"KG-{j}": rng.choice(list(DiscountScope)) for j in range(3)}
    for p in positions:
        if rng.random() < 0.4:
            p.scope = rng.choice(list(scope_keys))
        p.packaging = rng.random() < 0.5
        p.pool = rng.random() < 0.4
        p.bonus = rng.random() < 0.5
    pooled = {}
    for p in positions:
        pooled[p.mat.number] = pooled.get(p.mat.number, 0) + p.pieces
    for p in positions:
        if rng.random() < 0.3:
            number = p.mat.number if rng.random() < 0.7 else f"M-{seed}-other"
            ceiling = max(0, pooled[p.mat.number] + rng.choice([0, -1, 5]))
            p.commit = (number, ceiling, rng.randint(1, 3))
    t1 = money(rng, 200, 3000)
    bands = [(D(0), t1, D(0)), (t1, t1 + money(rng, 500, 5000), D(rng.choice([1, 2, 3]))),
             (None, None, D(rng.choice([4, 5])))]
    bands[2] = (bands[1][1], None, bands[2][2])
    world = World(positions, mats, fx=D(rng.randint(8000, 13000)) / 10000, approval=None, scope_keys=scope_keys,
                  tariff=money(rng, 1, 30), pool_fee=money(rng, 10, 900), bands=bands)
    if rng.random() < 0.85:
        percent = rng.choice([D(2), D("2.5"), D(3), D(5), D("7.5")])
        minimum = None
        if rng.random() < 0.5:
            value = reference_order_value(world)
            minimum = rng.choice([value, value + D("0.01"), value - D("0.01"), (value / 2).quantize(D("0.01")),
                                  value * 2])
        world.approval = (percent, minimum)
    world.no_bid = rng.random() < 0.1
    world.facts = render(world, rng)
    return world


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Reference (Fractions, written from the rule text, no engine code)


def r2(x: F) -> F:
    return F(math.floor(x * 100 + F(1, 2)), 100)


def base_price(world: World, p: TPos) -> F:
    reached = [price for minimum, price in p.mat.scales if minimum <= p.pieces]
    per_piece = F(reached[-1]) / p.mat.price_unit
    return r2(per_piece * F(world.fx)) if p.mat.usd else per_piece


def reference_order_value(world: World) -> D:
    value = r2(sum((p.pieces * base_price(world, p) for p in world.positions), F(0)))
    return D(value.numerator) / D(value.denominator)


def largest_remainder(total: F, weights: dict, order: list) -> dict:
    cents = int(total * 100)
    whole = sum(weights.values(), F(0))
    exact = {k: cents * w / whole for k, w in weights.items()}
    got = {k: math.floor(v) for k, v in exact.items()}
    rest = cents - sum(got.values())
    for k in sorted(weights, key=lambda k: (-(exact[k] - got[k]), order.index(k)))[:rest]:
        got[k] += 1
    return {k: F(v, 100) for k, v in got.items()}


def reference(world: World) -> dict:
    percent = F(0)
    if world.approval:
        pct, minimum = world.approval
        if minimum is None or (not world.no_bid and reference_order_value(world) >= minimum):
            percent = F(pct)
    head = {"tender_reference": REF, "currency": "EUR", "discount_percent": percent}
    if world.no_bid:
        return {**head, "decision": "no_bid", "positions": [], "total_net": F(0)}
    order = [p.id for p in world.positions]
    base = {p.id: base_price(world, p) for p in world.positions}
    pool = {p.id: F(0) for p in world.positions}
    members = [p for p in world.positions if p.pool]
    if members:
        pool.update(largest_remainder(F(world.pool_fee), {p.id: p.pieces * F(p.mat.alloc_kg) for p in members}, order))
    bonus = {p.id: F(0) for p in world.positions}
    members = [p for p in world.positions if p.bonus]
    if members:
        values = {p.id: p.pieces * base[p.id] for p in members}
        total = sum(values.values(), F(0))
        credit = F(0)
        for lower, upper, pct in world.bands:
            top = total if upper is None else min(total, F(upper))
            credit += max(F(0), top - F(lower)) * F(pct) / 100
        credit = r2(credit)
        if credit:
            bonus.update(largest_remainder(credit, values, order))
    pooled = {}
    for p in world.positions:
        pooled[p.mat.number] = pooled.get(p.mat.number, 0) + p.pieces
    keep = 1 - percent / 100
    out, total_net = [], F(0)
    for p in world.positions:
        m, q = p.mat, p.pieces
        mass = F(m.mass_kg) * F(m.index_rate) if m.index else F(0)
        packaging = math.ceil(F(q, m.carton)) * F(world.tariff) if p.packaging else F(0)
        scope = world.scope_keys[p.scope] if p.scope else DiscountScope.BASE
        b = base[p.id] * keep if scope in (DiscountScope.BASE, DiscountScope.BASE_AND_SURCHARGE) else base[p.id]
        s = mass * keep if scope == DiscountScope.BASE_AND_SURCHARGE else mass
        unit = r2(b + s + (F(m.setup) + pool[p.id] + packaging - bonus[p.id]) / q)
        if p.commit and p.commit[0] == m.number and pooled[m.number] <= p.commit[1]:
            lead = p.commit[2]
        else:
            lead = m.stock_lead if m.stock >= pooled[m.number] else m.prod_lead
        total_net += q * unit
        out.append({"position": p.id, "material_number": m.number, "quantity": q, "unit_price": unit,
                    "lead_time_weeks": lead, "base_unit_price": r2(base[p.id]),
                    "surcharge_per_unit": r2(mass + (F(m.setup) + pool[p.id]) / q),
                    "packaging_per_unit": r2(packaging / q), "rebate_total": bonus[p.id]})
    return {**head, "decision": "bid", "positions": out, "total_net": total_net}


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Rendering the truth into facts, with decoys


def render(w: World, rng: random.Random) -> Facts:
    clock = [datetime(2030, 3, 1, 8, 0, tzinfo=UTC)]

    def qa_time():
        clock[0] += timedelta(hours=rng.randint(1, 60))
        return clock[0]

    def true_time():          # a record date not after the scenario date (sometimes the same morning)
        return rng.choice([SCEN - timedelta(hours=rng.randint(1, 3)), SCEN - timedelta(days=rng.randint(1, 30))])

    def src(when, local="", domain=DOMAIN):
        return Source(date=when, sender=f"{local}@{domain}" if local else "")

    def keyed(make, local, key, true_value, other_value):
        """The authorized record plus decoys: superseded older, look-alike newer, future, wrong sender/domain."""
        t = true_time()
        return [make(REF, key, true_value, src(t, local)),
                make(REF, key, other_value, src(t - timedelta(days=rng.randint(1, 9)), local)),
                make(LOOK, key, other_value, src(SCEN - timedelta(minutes=30), local)),
                make(REF, key, other_value, src(SCEN + timedelta(minutes=rng.choice([1, 60 * 24])), local)),
                make(REF, key, other_value, src(SCEN - timedelta(minutes=10), "vertrieb")),
                make(REF, key, other_value, src(SCEN - timedelta(minutes=5), local, "other.test"))]

def as_dec(x) -> D:

"""Randomised scenarios against an independent reference.

A generator invents a tender (the ground truth), then writes it into facts the way messy sites present it: decoys
are added (superseded, look-alike, future-dated and wrong-sender records; inactive and near-miss materials; old
revisions and their amendments; withdrawn and superseded clarifications; expired and future price conditions), the
lists are shuffled, position numbers come in several styles and some keys come without a Q&A number. A deliberately
simple reference computes the expected answer from the ground truth alone, with Fractions instead of Decimal, so it
shares no code with the engine. Every answer field must agree. All data is invented.
"""
import math
import random
import unittest
from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from datetime import date, datetime, timedelta, timezone
from decimal import Decimal as D
from fractions import Fraction as F

import test_engine_base  # noqa: F401  (puts agent/ on the path)

from engine import evaluate
from facts import (Assignment, AssignmentKind as K, Attr, BonusBand, ConditionGroupRule, DeliveryCommitment,
                   DiscountApproval, DiscountScope, EndReserve, Facts, FxRate, IndexWindow, Material, MetalIndex,
                   PackagingTariff, PriceCondition, ProjectBonus, QuantityChange, Requirement, Scale, SetupPool, Source,
                   SpecRevision, TechnicalAmendment, TenderPosition, Unit, Withdrawal)

SEEDS = range(300)
UTC = timezone.utc
SCEN = datetime(2030, 6, 15, 12, 0, tzinfo=UTC)
REF, LOOK = "T-RND-7", "T-RND-7-X"
DOMAIN, DIRECTOR = "bidder.test", "chef@bidder.test"


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Ground truth


@dataclass
class TMat:
    number: str
    group: str
    bore: int
    stroke: int                 # nominal stroke, what the ERP shows
    pressure: int
    mounting: str
    cert: str                   # "" = none
    stock: int
    stock_lead: int
    prod_lead: int
    carton: int
    alloc_kg: D
    mass_kg: D
    index: str                  # "" = no metal index
    index_rate: D
    setup: D
    usd: bool
    price_unit: int
    scales: list                # [(min pieces, price per price_unit)]
    usable: bool = False        # the requirement states usable travel
    reserve: int = 0


@dataclass
class TPos:
    id: str
    mat: TMat
    is_set: bool
    pps: int                    # pieces per set of its requirement
    tender_qty: int             # in the position's unit
    stated: int                 # final quantity in the position's unit
    scope: DiscountScope | None = None
    packaging: bool = False
    pool: bool = False
    bonus: bool = False
    commit: tuple | None = None  # (material number, ceiling, weeks)

    @property
    def pieces(self):
        return self.stated * (self.pps if self.is_set else 1)


@dataclass
class World:
    positions: list
    mats: list
    fx: D
    approval: tuple | None      # (percent, min order value or None)
    scope_keys: dict            # key -> scope
    tariff: D
    pool_fee: D
    bands: list                 # [(lower, upper or None, percent)]
    no_bid: bool = False
    facts: Facts = None
    notes: list = field(default_factory=list)


def money(rng, lo, hi):
    return D(rng.randint(int(lo * 100), int(hi * 100))) / 100


def invent(seed: int) -> World:
    rng = random.Random(seed)
    n = rng.randint(1, 5)
    style = rng.choice(["num", "tens", "dotted", "alpha"])
    ids = [{"num": str(i + 1), "tens": str(10 * (i + 1)), "dotted": f"1.{i + 1}", "alpha": f"P-{i + 1:02d}"}[style]
           for i in range(n)]
    k = rng.randint(1, n)
    mats = []
    for i in range(k):
        price_unit = rng.choice([1, 1, 10, 100])
        mins = sorted({1, rng.randint(2, 15), rng.randint(16, 60)})
        price = money(rng, 20, 900) * price_unit
        scales = []
        for m in mins:
            scales.append((m, price))
            price = (price * D(rng.randint(85, 99)) / 100).quantize(D("0.01"))
        mats.append(TMat(
            number=f"M-{seed}-{i}", group=f"G-{i}", bore=rng.choice([32, 40, 50, 63, 80, 100]),
            stroke=200 + 60 * i + 10 * rng.randint(0, 4), pressure=rng.choice([160, 200, 210, 250]),
            mounting=rng.choice(["Flansch", "Schwenkauge", "Fußbefestigung", "Gewindezapfen"]),
            cert=rng.choice(["", "", "EN 1000", "EN 2000"]), stock=rng.randint(0, 60), stock_lead=rng.randint(1, 3),
            prod_lead=rng.randint(4, 12), carton=rng.randint(1, 12), alloc_kg=D(rng.randint(500, 5000)) / 1000,
            mass_kg=D(rng.randint(100, 2000)) / 1000, index=rng.choice(["", f"IX-{i}", f"IX-{i}"]),
            index_rate=money(rng, 1.5, 5), setup=rng.choice([D(0), money(rng, 10, 200)]), usd=rng.random() < 0.3,
            price_unit=price_unit, scales=scales, usable=rng.random() < 0.3, reserve=rng.randint(3, 15)))
    positions = []
    for i, pid in enumerate(ids):
        mat = mats[i] if i < k else rng.choice(mats)
        is_set = rng.random() < 0.25
        tender = rng.randint(1, 20) if is_set else rng.randint(1, 80)
        stated = rng.choice([tender, tender, rng.randint(1, 80)])
        positions.append(TPos(pid, mat, is_set, rng.randint(2, 6), tender, stated))
    # pieces per set belong to the requirement: positions of one material share them
    for p in positions:
        p.pps = next(q.pps for q in positions if q.mat is p.mat)
    scope_keys = {f"KG-{j}": rng.choice(list(DiscountScope)) for j in range(3)}
    for p in positions:
        if rng.random() < 0.4:
            p.scope = rng.choice(list(scope_keys))
        p.packaging = rng.random() < 0.5
        p.pool = rng.random() < 0.4
        p.bonus = rng.random() < 0.5
    pooled = {}
    for p in positions:
        pooled[p.mat.number] = pooled.get(p.mat.number, 0) + p.pieces
    for p in positions:
        if rng.random() < 0.3:
            number = p.mat.number if rng.random() < 0.7 else f"M-{seed}-other"
            ceiling = max(0, pooled[p.mat.number] + rng.choice([0, -1, 5]))
            p.commit = (number, ceiling, rng.randint(1, 3))
    t1 = money(rng, 200, 3000)
    bands = [(D(0), t1, D(0)), (t1, t1 + money(rng, 500, 5000), D(rng.choice([1, 2, 3]))),
             (None, None, D(rng.choice([4, 5])))]
    bands[2] = (bands[1][1], None, bands[2][2])
    world = World(positions, mats, fx=D(rng.randint(8000, 13000)) / 10000, approval=None, scope_keys=scope_keys,
                  tariff=money(rng, 1, 30), pool_fee=money(rng, 10, 900), bands=bands)
    if rng.random() < 0.85:
        percent = rng.choice([D(2), D("2.5"), D(3), D(5), D("7.5")])
        minimum = None
        if rng.random() < 0.5:
            value = reference_order_value(world)
            minimum = rng.choice([value, value + D("0.01"), value - D("0.01"), (value / 2).quantize(D("0.01")),
                                  value * 2])
        world.approval = (percent, minimum)
    world.no_bid = rng.random() < 0.1
    world.facts = render(world, rng)
    return world


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Reference (Fractions, written from the rule text, no engine code)


def r2(x: F) -> F:
    return F(math.floor(x * 100 + F(1, 2)), 100)


def base_price(world: World, p: TPos) -> F:
    reached = [price for minimum, price in p.mat.scales if minimum <= p.pieces]
    per_piece = F(reached[-1]) / p.mat.price_unit
    return r2(per_piece * F(world.fx)) if p.mat.usd else per_piece


def reference_order_value(world: World) -> D:
    value = r2(sum((p.pieces * base_price(world, p) for p in world.positions), F(0)))
    return D(value.numerator) / D(value.denominator)


def largest_remainder(total: F, weights: dict, order: list) -> dict:
    cents = int(total * 100)
    whole = sum(weights.values(), F(0))
    exact = {k: cents * w / whole for k, w in weights.items()}
    got = {k: math.floor(v) for k, v in exact.items()}
    rest = cents - sum(got.values())
    for k in sorted(weights, key=lambda k: (-(exact[k] - got[k]), order.index(k)))[:rest]:
        got[k] += 1
    return {k: F(v, 100) for k, v in got.items()}


def reference(world: World) -> dict:
    percent = F(0)
    if world.approval:
        pct, minimum = world.approval
        if minimum is None or (not world.no_bid and reference_order_value(world) >= minimum):
            percent = F(pct)
    head = {"tender_reference": REF, "currency": "EUR", "discount_percent": percent}
    if world.no_bid:
        return {**head, "decision": "no_bid", "positions": [], "total_net": F(0)}
    order = [p.id for p in world.positions]
    base = {p.id: base_price(world, p) for p in world.positions}
    pool = {p.id: F(0) for p in world.positions}
    members = [p for p in world.positions if p.pool]
    if members:
        pool.update(largest_remainder(F(world.pool_fee), {p.id: p.pieces * F(p.mat.alloc_kg) for p in members}, order))
    bonus = {p.id: F(0) for p in world.positions}
    members = [p for p in world.positions if p.bonus]
    if members:
        values = {p.id: p.pieces * base[p.id] for p in members}
        total = sum(values.values(), F(0))
        credit = F(0)
        for lower, upper, pct in world.bands:
            top = total if upper is None else min(total, F(upper))
            credit += max(F(0), top - F(lower)) * F(pct) / 100
        credit = r2(credit)
        if credit:
            bonus.update(largest_remainder(credit, values, order))
    pooled = {}
    for p in world.positions:
        pooled[p.mat.number] = pooled.get(p.mat.number, 0) + p.pieces
    keep = 1 - percent / 100
    out, total_net = [], F(0)
    for p in world.positions:
        m, q = p.mat, p.pieces
        mass = F(m.mass_kg) * F(m.index_rate) if m.index else F(0)
        packaging = math.ceil(F(q, m.carton)) * F(world.tariff) if p.packaging else F(0)
        scope = world.scope_keys[p.scope] if p.scope else DiscountScope.BASE
        b = base[p.id] * keep if scope in (DiscountScope.BASE, DiscountScope.BASE_AND_SURCHARGE) else base[p.id]
        s = mass * keep if scope == DiscountScope.BASE_AND_SURCHARGE else mass
        unit = r2(b + s + (F(m.setup) + pool[p.id] + packaging - bonus[p.id]) / q)
        if p.commit and p.commit[0] == m.number and pooled[m.number] <= p.commit[1]:
            lead = p.commit[2]
        else:
            lead = m.stock_lead if m.stock >= pooled[m.number] else m.prod_lead
        total_net += q * unit
        out.append({"position": p.id, "material_number": m.number, "quantity": q, "unit_price": unit,
                    "lead_time_weeks": lead, "base_unit_price": r2(base[p.id]),
                    "surcharge_per_unit": r2(mass + (F(m.setup) + pool[p.id]) / q),
                    "packaging_per_unit": r2(packaging / q), "rebate_total": bonus[p.id]})
    return {**head, "decision": "bid", "positions": out, "total_net": total_net}


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Rendering the truth into facts, with decoys


def render(w: World, rng: random.Random) -> Facts:
    clock = [datetime(2030, 3, 1, 8, 0, tzinfo=UTC)]

    def qa_time():
        clock[0] += timedelta(hours=rng.randint(1, 60))
        return clock[0]

    def true_time():          # a record date not after the scenario date (sometimes the same morning)
        return rng.choice([SCEN - timedelta(hours=rng.randint(1, 3)), SCEN - timedelta(days=rng.randint(1, 30))])

    def src(when, local="", domain=DOMAIN):
        return Source(date=when, sender=f"{local}@{domain}" if local else "")

    def keyed(make, local, key, true_value, other_value):
        """The authorized record plus decoys: superseded older, look-alike newer, future, wrong sender/domain."""
        t = true_time()
        return [make(REF, key, true_value, src(t, local)),
                make(REF, key, other_value, src(t - timedelta(days=rng.randint(1, 9)), local)),
                make(LOOK, key, other_value, src(SCEN - timedelta(minutes=30), local)),
                make(REF, key, other_value, src(SCEN + timedelta(minutes=rng.choice([1, 60 * 24])), local)),
                make(REF, key, other_value, src(SCEN - timedelta(minutes=10), "vertrieb")),
                make(REF, key, other_value, src(SCEN - timedelta(minutes=5), local, "other.test"))]

    f = Facts(tender_reference=REF, scenario_date=SCEN, bidder_domain=DOMAIN, director_address=DIRECTOR)
    numbers = iter(range(1, 1000))

    # revisions, requirements, amendments, end reserves
    cur, old = f"REV-{rng.randint(100, 999)}", f"REV-{rng.randint(1000, 1999)}"
    cur_reqs, old_reqs = [], []
    for m in w.mats:
        p_set = next(p for p in w.positions if p.mat is m)
        stroke = m.stroke - 2 * m.reserve if m.usable else m.stroke
        req = Requirement(f"A{m.group}", D(m.bore), D(stroke), D(m.pressure), m.mounting,
                          m.cert or rng.choice(["keine gefordert", "", None]), catalogue_group=m.group,
                          pieces_per_set=D(p_set.pps), usable_travel=m.usable, end_reserve_key=f"E-{m.group}")
        if rng.random() < 0.5:        # the revision states another value; the latest amendment restores the truth
            attr, wrong, right = ((Attr.STROKE, req.stroke_mm + 20, req.stroke_mm) if rng.random() < 0.5
                                  else (Attr.PRESSURE, D(m.pressure + 5), D(m.pressure)))
            req = Requirement(**{**req.__dict__, attr.value: wrong})
            f.amendments += [
                TechnicalAmendment(cur, req.requirement, attr, str(wrong + 1), f"F-{next(numbers)}", src(qa_time())),
                TechnicalAmendment(cur, req.requirement, attr, str(right), f"F-{next(numbers)}", src(qa_time())),
                TechnicalAmendment(old, req.requirement, attr, str(wrong + 2), f"F-{next(numbers)}", src(qa_time()))]
        cur_reqs.append(req)
        old_reqs.append(Requirement(**{**req.__dict__, "stroke_mm": req.stroke_mm + 10}))
        if m.usable:
            f.end_reserves += keyed(lambda r, k, v, s: EndReserve(r, k, cur, D(v), s), "technik", f"E-{m.group}",
                                    m.reserve, m.reserve + 2)
            f.end_reserves.append(EndReserve(REF, f"E-{m.group}", old, D(m.reserve + 5), src(true_time(), "technik")))
    f.revisions = [SpecRevision(cur, True, date(2030, 2, rng.randint(1, 28)), cur_reqs),
                   SpecRevision(old, rng.choice([False, None]), date(2030, rng.choice([1, 3]), 10), old_reqs)]

    # positions and clarifications
    for p in w.positions:
        f.positions.append(TenderPosition(p.id, D(p.tender_qty), Unit.SET if p.is_set else Unit.PIECE,
                                          f"A{p.mat.group}"))
        wrong = p.stated + rng.randint(1, 9)
        story = rng.choice(["none", "change", "two", "withdrawn_later", "withdrawn_only"])
        if p.stated != p.tender_qty and story in ("none", "withdrawn_only"):
            story = "change"
        if story in ("change", "withdrawn_later"):
            f.quantity_changes.append(QuantityChange(p.id, D(p.stated), f"F-{next(numbers)}", src(qa_time())))
        if story == "two":
            f.quantity_changes.append(QuantityChange(p.id, D(wrong), f"F-{next(numbers)}", src(qa_time())))
            f.quantity_changes.append(QuantityChange(p.id, D(p.stated), f"F-{next(numbers)}", src(qa_time())))
        if story in ("withdrawn_later", "withdrawn_only"):
            n = f"F-{next(numbers)}"
            f.quantity_changes.append(QuantityChange(p.id, D(wrong), n, src(qa_time())))
            f.withdrawals.append(Withdrawal(f"F-{next(numbers)}", n, src(qa_time())))

    # materials with decoys and price conditions
    removed = rng.choice(w.mats).number if w.no_bid else None
    for m in w.mats:
        valid = PriceCondition(datetime(2030, 1, 1, tzinfo=UTC), datetime(2030, 12, 31, 23, 59, 59, tzinfo=UTC),
                               "USD" if m.usd else "EUR", "FX-1" if m.usd else "", D(m.price_unit),
                               [Scale(D(q), price) for q, price in m.scales])
        expired = PriceCondition(date(2029, 1, 1), date(2029, 12, 31), "EUR", "", D(1), [Scale(D(1), D("1.11"))])
        future = PriceCondition(SCEN + timedelta(hours=1), None, "EUR", "", D(1), [Scale(D(1), D("2.22"))])
        true = Material(m.number, True, m.group, D(m.bore), D(m.stroke), D(m.pressure),
                        rng.choice([m.mounting, m.mounting.lower(), m.mounting.upper()]),
                        m.cert or rng.choice(["", None, "keine"]), D(m.stock), m.stock_lead, m.prod_lead,
                        D(m.carton), m.alloc_kg, m.mass_kg, m.index, m.setup, rng.sample([valid, expired, future], 3))
        decoys = [Material(**{**true.__dict__, "material_number": m.number + "-I", "active": False}),
                  Material(**{**true.__dict__, "material_number": m.number + "-N",
                              rng.choice(["bore_mm", "pressure_bar", "stroke_mm"]): D(rng.choice([1, 2, 3, 4])) +
                              getattr(true, "bore_mm")})]
        if m.usable:     # the trap: a material whose stroke is the usable travel without reserves
            decoys.append(Material(**{**true.__dict__, "material_number": m.number + "-U",
                                      "stroke_mm": D(m.stroke - 2 * m.reserve)}))
        f.materials += decoys + ([] if m.number == removed else [true])
        if m.index:
            day = SCEN.date()
            start = rng.choice([day, day - timedelta(days=rng.randint(1, 40))])
            end = rng.choice([day, day + timedelta(days=rng.randint(1, 40))])
            windows = [IndexWindow(m.index_rate + 1, None, start - timedelta(days=1)),
                       IndexWindow(m.index_rate, start, end), IndexWindow(m.index_rate + 2, end + timedelta(days=1))]
            rng.shuffle(windows)
            f.metal_indices += keyed(lambda r, k, v, s: MetalIndex(r, k, v, s), "kalkulation", m.index, windows,
                                     [IndexWindow(m.index_rate + 3)])
    f.searched_groups = [m.group for m in w.mats]
    f.fx_rates = keyed(lambda r, k, v, s: FxRate(r, k, "USD", v, s), "finanzen", "FX-1", w.fx, w.fx + D("0.1"))

    # keys and their assignments (some without a Q&A number, as if read from another site)
    def assign(p, kind, key):
        number = rng.choice([f"F-{next(numbers)}", ""])
        if rng.random() < 0.3:      # an older assignment to another key, replaced by the true one
            f.assignments.append(Assignment(p.id, kind, key + "-OLD", "", src(qa_time())))
        f.assignments.append(Assignment(p.id, kind, key, number, src(qa_time())))

    for key, scope in w.scope_keys.items():
        other = rng.choice([s for s in DiscountScope if s != scope])
        f.condition_groups += keyed(lambda r, k, v, s: ConditionGroupRule(r, k, v, s), "kalkulation", key, scope, other)
    f.packaging_tariffs = keyed(lambda r, k, v, s: PackagingTariff(r, k, v, s), "logistik", "VP-1", w.tariff,
                                w.tariff + 7)
    f.packaging_tariffs.append(PackagingTariff(REF, "VP-1-OLD", D(99), src(true_time(), "logistik")))
    f.setup_pools = keyed(lambda r, k, v, s: SetupPool(r, k, v, s), "kalkulation", "RP-1", w.pool_fee,
                          w.pool_fee + 50)
    bands = [BonusBand(lo, hi, pct) for lo, hi, pct in w.bands]
    f.project_bonuses = keyed(lambda r, k, v, s: ProjectBonus(r, k, v, s), "finanzen", "PB-1", bands,
                              [BonusBand(D(0), None, D(20))])
    for p in w.positions:
        if p.scope:
            assign(p, K.CONDITION_GROUP, p.scope)
        if p.packaging:
            assign(p, K.PACKAGING, "VP-1")
        if p.pool:
            assign(p, K.SETUP_POOL, "RP-1")
        if p.bonus:
            assign(p, K.PROJECT_BONUS, "PB-1")
        if p.commit:
            key = f"TZ-{p.id}"
            number, ceiling, weeks = p.commit
            f.delivery_commitments += keyed(
                lambda r, k, v, s: DeliveryCommitment(r, k, number, D(ceiling), v, s), "logistik", key, weeks, 0)
            assign(p, K.DELIVERY, key)

    if w.approval:
        pct, minimum = w.approval
        t = true_time()
        f.discount_approvals = [
            DiscountApproval(REF, pct, minimum, src(t, "chef")),
            DiscountApproval(REF, D(1), None, src(t - timedelta(days=2), "chef")),
            DiscountApproval(LOOK, D(9), None, src(SCEN - timedelta(minutes=20), "chef")),
            DiscountApproval(REF, D(9), None, src(SCEN + timedelta(minutes=1), "chef")),
            DiscountApproval(REF, D(9), None, src(SCEN - timedelta(minutes=10), "vertrieb"))]

    for items in (f.positions, f.quantity_changes, f.withdrawals, f.amendments, f.assignments, f.materials,
                  f.discount_approvals, f.condition_groups, f.metal_indices, f.packaging_tariffs,
                  f.delivery_commitments, f.fx_rates, f.setup_pools, f.project_bonuses, f.end_reserves, f.revisions):
        rng.shuffle(items)
    return f


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------


def as_dec(x) -> D:
    if isinstance(x, F):
        return D(x.numerator) / D(x.denominator)
    return D(str(x))


class RandomScenarios(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_engine_matches_reference(self):
        for seed in SEEDS:
            with self.subTest(seed=seed):
                world = invent(seed)
                result = evaluate(world.facts)
                want, got = reference(world), result.answer
                self.assertEqual(result.incomplete, [])
                self.assertEqual(got["decision"], want["decision"])
                for name in ("tender_reference", "currency"):
                    self.assertEqual(got[name], want[name])
                for name in ("discount_percent", "total_net"):
                    self.assertEqual(as_dec(got[name]), as_dec(want[name]), name)
                self.assertEqual([p["position"] for p in got["positions"]],
                                 [p["position"] for p in want["positions"]])
                for g, e in zip(got["positions"], want["positions"]):
                    self.assertEqual(set(g), set(e), g["position"])
                    for name in e:
                        if isinstance(e[name], str):
                            self.assertEqual(g[name], e[name], (g["position"], name))
                        else:
                            self.assertEqual(as_dec(g[name]), as_dec(e[name]), (g["position"], name))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()

content.text:
Both steps are done. All 86 engine tests pass, and the 3 new commits are local; I haven't pushed them yet.

**Step 1: fewer assumptions about the sites**
- **Keys and changes from any site:** quantity changes, technical amendments and key assignments no longer need a Q&A number. They can now come from the ERP or any other site, which matters because the final run splits the information differently. This changes the field order in `facts.py`: the Q&A number now comes after the values.
- **No guessing on ambiguous numbers:** from JSON, text like "1.250" (thousands or decimals?) is now rejected with an error that names the field. JSON numbers and text whose format is clear always pass.
- **Guidance for the model:** the JSON Schema now describes the fields that are easy to fill wrongly: grams vs kg, null for "no certification required", price per 100 pieces, and recording ERP searches that found nothing.

**Step 2: random scenarios checked against a separate reference**
- **What it does:** 300 invented tenders, each written into facts with decoys added (old and look-alike records, future-dated and wrong-sender mails, inactive and near-miss materials, old revisions, withdrawn answers, expired prices). The lists are shuffled and position numbers come in four styles.
- **How it checks:** a deliberately simple implementation of the rules, sharing no code with the engine, computes the expected answer, and every field must match.
- **Coverage:** 816 positions and 26 `no_bid` cases. Every price layer appears hundreds of times, and each borderline case occurs both ways.
- **Is the test strong enough?** I planted 12 bugs in the engine one at a time, for example ignoring withdrawn answers, skipping the date or sender check, or pricing at the wrong scale. The test caught every one.

The limit is still the same: none of this tests the facts that come from the real websites.

Orhun needs to know about the field-order change if he already builds those records by position. That's in the push-log entry.

Should I push these 3 commits to `stream-i`?

content.content:
# Getting started: from sign-in to your first scored run

How to sign in, set up and test your agent, and get it on the leaderboard. Limits and scoring are at the bottom.

Fastest start: point Claude Code or Codex at this site. Paste this, and it installs the CLI, connects itself, and helps you build, test and submit:

```text
Read https://ehl-challenge.atira.ai/llms.txt, then set us up and help us build, test and submit an agent for this challenge.
```

Web page: [https://ehl-challenge.atira.ai/start](https://ehl-challenge.atira.ai/start) · The challenge: [Markdown](https://ehl-challenge.atira.ai/challenges/rfq.md) · For agents: [llms.txt](https://ehl-challenge.atira.ai/llms.txt) · [OpenAPI](https://ehl-challenge.atira.ai/openapi.json) · [API guide](https://ehl-challenge.atira.ai/docs/api.md) · [CLI](https://ehl-challenge.atira.ai/docs/cli.md)

## What you're building

Your agent reads a public tender, finds the current specification, checks prices and stock in the ERP, looks up the approved discount in the sales inbox and submits one signed bid. Bring any frontier model, your own tools and prompts, up to four browsers in parallel; no human in the loop. Or use [ours](https://ehl-challenge.atira.ai/start#models): unlimited Qwen3.8-Flash-Next and Cloudflare Clef inference. Free for you. Each call still adds its simulated price to your run's cost, so the cost ranking stays fair. Every scored submission runs once on the public dataset. Eligible answers rank first, then higher quality, then lower cost × time. When the hackathon ends, every team's latest submission that passed review runs once by default, or best of three if the team opts in before the final run starts, on a private dataset. We pick the winners on three things, roughly in this order: performance on the private dataset, performance on the public dataset, and the elegance of the system.

## Your first test run

### Qwen3.8-Flash-Next

#6 on the [Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index](https://artificialanalysis.ai/models/qwen3-8-flash-next) (open-weight, large models). Multimodal general-purpose LLM. Strong at reasoning, tool calls and reading pages and screenshots, with a 256k context, so it can plan, browse and write the answer.

- **Limits:** No usage cap. Up to 32 calls per team at once, across all its runs; more wait in line.
- **Simulated pricing:**
  - Input: $0.15 / M tokens
  - Cached input: $0.016 / M tokens
  - Cache writes: Free
  - Output: $0.47 / M tokens

import os

### Cloudflare Clef

A multimodal decision model. Give it a state and up to 4 screenshots, then ask it questions: `choice` picks one of your options, `noul` gives the probability of yes, from 0 to 1, and `score` rates on a scale you set. See [Cloudflare's announcement](https://blog.cloudflare.com/clef-decision-models/) and [the benchmarks](https://clef-evals.workers-ai-mle.workers.dev). Worth a try for quick, low-stakes decisions, such as which link to open or whether a page is the right document, while the bigger model reads and reasons.

- **Limits:** No usage cap. Up to 16 calls per team at once, across all its runs; more wait in line.
- **Simulated pricing:**
  - Input: $0.24 / M tokens
  - Output: Not priced

Scales to zero when idle, but warm-up isn't counted toward a submission's time.

```sh
curl "$CLEF_BASE_URL/v1/decide" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $CLEF_API_KEY" \
  -H 'content-type: application/json' -d '{
  "state": {"page": "Checkout returns 502"},
  "questions": {"next": {
    "type": "choice",
    "instructions": "What next?",
    "criteria": {
      "retry": "Retry the request",
      "report": "Report the error"}}}}'
```

In a run, `QWEN_BASE_URL` with `QWEN_API_KEY` and `CLEF_BASE_URL` with `CLEF_API_KEY` are set for you. On your machine, `atira models proxy` serves the same APIs on 127.0.0.1, so the same code works in both. Calls from your machine are free, recorded and never ranked. An idle model can take several minutes to wake on its first call, so use long timeouts.

```sh
atira login   # once per computer
atira models proxy   # keep it running; it prints:
export QWEN_BASE_URL=http://127.0.0.1:8765/qwen/v1
export QWEN_API_KEY=local
export CLEF_BASE_URL=http://127.0.0.1:8765/clef
export CLEF_API_KEY=local
```

Cost and time count toward your rank, and a call to these models costs a fraction of a frontier call. Use them for the easy steps.

If one fails mid-run, retry the call, as with any provider. If they were down for most of a run that then ended without an answer, the platform failed, not your agent system: the run doesn't count, and a scored run starts again once by itself.

## Limits

What every scored run gets.

| Rule | What it means |
| --- | --- |
| Scored run | 20 minutes on the clock. Each submission runs once; one submission in flight per team. |
| Setup and network | Setup doesn't count toward your time: it has network access and up to 5 minutes to install what you need. The timed run reaches only the platform, the websites and the model proxy. |
| Models | Bring your own keys as team secrets, for Anthropic, OpenAI, OpenRouter, Google, Groq, Mistral, DeepSeek, xAI, Together, Fireworks. Every call goes through the run's proxy and is metered at the published prices. Qwen3.8-Flash-Next and Cloudflare Clef are ours, unlimited. Free for you. Each call still adds its simulated price to your run's cost, so the cost ranking stays fair. |
| Browsers | At most 4 Chromium browsers at a time, provided by the sandbox; any number of tabs. |
| Sandbox | 4 vCPU, 8 GB memory and 30 GB disk on AMD Zen 5; 1280×800 screens. Node 24 with pnpm and bun, Python 3.12 with uv, Rust with cargo. |
| Package | Up to 20 MB compressed, with `agent.json` at the root. Its `"models"` lists the hosted models your agent calls (`["qwen", "clef"]` when absent); the run waits only for those to warm up, and `"models": []` starts it right after setup. |
| Fair play | The answer must come from the websites at run time, found by a model that does the navigating and deciding, not a fixed script or a crawler. A coding agent reviews every package. The final run uses a private dataset: the same jobs, bid rules and answer format, on different websites with other content and data. [Full rules](https://ehl-challenge.atira.ai/docs/fair-play.md). |
| Team | Up to 5 people. |

## How you're scored

Every scored run gets a quality and an eligibility verdict; the platform measures its cost and time.

- **Quality:** 0 to 100. Every field of the bid is compared with the one correct answer: tender reference, positions, materials, quantities, unit prices, lead times, discount and total, each position's base price and surcharge per piece, packaging, allocated project bonus, and whether the total adds up.
- **Eligibility:** The right tender reference; a wrong decision loses quality points but other correct fields keep their credit. A bid that is not eligible ranks after every eligible one.

Order: Eligible first → Quality ↓ → Cost × time ↑.

Eligible answers rank first, then higher quality. At equal quality, the lower product of cost and time wins, with cost counted as at least $0.01 and time as at least 1 s, so among free runs the faster one wins.

On the leaderboard's plot, each dot is a team, quality against cost or time. The dotted line is the Pareto front. The quickest and cheapest passing solution might also get a small prize ;) [Answers and scoring](https://ehl-challenge.atira.ai/docs/scoring.md) has every point.

## Public and private data

The leaderboard uses the public dataset (public-1), the websites and data you scout and test on. Each submission runs once on it. We don't publish the correct answer. Test runs and the scouting logins use it too. When the hackathon ends, we run each team's latest submission that passed review once by default, or best of three if the team opts in before the final run starts, on a private dataset. It is similar, not the same: the same jobs, the same bid rules and the same answer format, but different websites (other software, layout, navigation and site names), other content and data, and the information split differently across them. Your agent has to handle them as it finds them. That run weighs most when we pick the winners, so don't tune your agent to the public scenario. We pick the winners on three things, roughly in this order: performance on the private dataset, performance on the public dataset, and the elegance of the system.

Eligible answers rank first, then higher quality. At equal quality, the lower product of cost and time wins, with cost counted as at least $0.01 and time as at least 1 s, so among free runs the faster one wins.

On the leaderboard's plot, each dot is a team, quality against cost or time. The dotted line is the Pareto front. The quickest and cheapest passing solution might also get a small prize ;) [Answers and scoring](https://ehl-challenge.atira.ai/docs/scoring.md) has every point.

The leaderboard uses the public dataset (public-1), the websites and data you scout and test on. Each submission runs once on it. We don't publish the correct answer. When the hackathon ends, we run each team's latest submission that passed review once by default, or best of three if the team opts in before the final run starts, on a private dataset. Your agent has to handle them as it finds them. That run weighs most when we pick the winners, so don't tune your agent to the public scenario. We pick the winners on three things, roughly in this order: performance on the private dataset, performance on the public dataset, and the elegance of the system.

Point it at [https://ehl-challenge.atira.ai/llms.txt](https://ehl-challenge.atira.ai/llms.txt); the home page, Getting started, each challenge, its leaderboard and each team's profile are also Markdown (add `.md` to the URL, `/index.md` for the home page), the API is described in [openapi.json](https://ehl-challenge.atira.ai/openapi.json), and the [API guide](https://ehl-challenge.atira.ai/docs/api.md) shows every call with curl.

Or plug the CLI in as an MCP server: your agent lists your runs, queries their logs by time, sees a browser's screen at any moment, starts test runs and, once you confirm, submits. [Debug runs from your coding agent](https://ehl-challenge.atira.ai/docs/mcp.md) has the tools and other clients.

```sh
claude mcp add atira -- atira mcp   # Claude Code
codex mcp add atira -- atira mcp    # Codex
```
